response.overview: Yes, You can add a person on Silversea Cruises booking by calling +1-866-254-7549 or contacting your travel agent. To add Passengers to a Silversea Cruise, you must call Silversea Cruise directly at ☎ +1-866-254-7549(US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151(UK) or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online. Additions depend on statePassenger capacity, ship lifeboat capacity, and current availability ☎ +1-866-254-7549(US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151(UK). The booking will likely be re-priced at current rates. To add someone to an existing Silversea Cruise Passenger, you must call Silversea Cruise directly at ☎ +1-866-254-7549(US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151(UK), or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done via the website or app. Adding a guest is subject to cabin capacity (third/fourth berths) and overall ship safety capacity ☎ +1-866-254-7549(US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151(UK). Customer Service & Reservations: Call +1 (866) 254‑7549 (US) or +1 (866) 254-7549 (UK) |
